messages:
Maria K: Quick check — onboarding zenith-13b. Where are the final weights? I ran a tiny perf sweep (batch 1..8) on the 16GB shard image and hit OOM at batch 4 for seq_len 1024. Also seeing weird tokenizer outputs: leading 0 token in some samples. @Ashwin any hints?

Ashwin: weights are at s3://redwood-models/zenith/13b/v2/zenith-13b-2026-03-08.tar.gz (sha256: 3a7f9c2d4b6e8f1a9c0d2e5f6b7a8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8g9h0i1j2k3l4m5).

Maria K: thanks, added link to the internals ticket #3421. The tar includes HF tokenizer files plus a pre-tokenizer.json.

Kevin L: Tokenizer note — zenith's tokenizer uses an unusual "pad_token_id": 0 and reserves 1 for <unk>. That interacts poorly with our batched padding code. Patch we use:
```python
# temporary fix in tokenizer adapter
if tokenizer.pad_token_id == 0:
    tokenizer.pad_token_id = tokenizer.eos_token_id
```

Kevin L: This prevents collisions with our padding-merge logic. Will open PR shortly.

Maria K: perf-bot started perf sweep: small->medium batches, 16GB node, pinned to cuda:0. Run id: perf-1790123456-1 :bar_chart: 

perf-bot: Sweep finished. Summary: batch 4/seq1024 OOM on g4dn.xlarge, batch 2/seq512 small regressed latency vs baseline. Full logs: https://internal/perf/1790123456 (access: redwood-corp).

Samir R: Can you attach the serving config you used? especially kv_cache=true vs false and prefill flags.

Maria K: serving config pasted:
```yaml
model: zenith-13b
quant: int8
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
  max_batch_size: 8
kv_cache: true
prefill: true
```

Jess: small note — for catalog entry we want two variants: zenith-13b (standard) and zenith-13b-compact (quant+kv off) to avoid 16GB node OOMs. Suggest default routes to compact for low memory tiers.

Ashwin: Agreed. I'll add tokenizer adapter to model conversion script so pad_token_id is fixed at load-time. Also will run a quick benchmark across node types and upload normalized p99/median numbers.

Maria K: Perfect. Action items: (1) Kevin to PR tokenizer adapter, (2) Ashwin to run full node sweep and upload metrics, (3) Jess to draft catalog variants. I'll follow up in the ticket. :thumbsup:

Kevin L: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/zenith/pull/128 — includes test vectors and unit tests for pad/prefill cases.

Ashwin: Starting node sweep now, ETA ~2h.

Maria K: Thanks all — ping me if perf numbers show different behavior on Dedicated or Dedicated-reserved profiles.
